subject.title: fix: normalize provider keys during model config merge

question: Should generated models configuration treat provider ids as fully case-insensitive and collapse case-colliding existing entries during merge?
rationale: The shared provider-id contract lowercases ids and the repair consistently follows it, but applying that contract to persisted map keys can merge previously distinct entries and change which settings or credentials survive an upgrade.

options.title: Accept canonical identity
options.body: Confirm provider ids are case-insensitive, refresh the branch against main, and merge with deterministic collision coverage.

options.title: Reject persisted-key collapse
options.body: Keep stored provider keys distinct and redesign the repair to match canonical providers without rewriting or merging case-distinct persisted entries.

options.title: Require migration handling
options.body: Canonicalize provider ids but add an explicit doctor migration or collision diagnostic before runtime merge behavior changes.

recommendation.title: Accept canonical identity
recommendation.body: Confirm provider ids are case-insensitive, refresh the branch against main, and merge with deterministic collision coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent provider merge and model configuration history is the closest available routing signal for this compatibility choice.
